items.title: August IPOs strike gold as listing gains top 100%, investor base expands
items.description: Eighteen mainland IPOs raised ₹28,976 crore and carry ₹2.48 lakh crore of market value - 8.6 times the capital raised.

items.title: Pranav Constructions IPO set for debut after 120x subscription; GMP at 36%
items.description: Pranav Constructions IPO GMP: Shares of Pranav Constructions were trading at ₹169 in the unofficial market ahead of stock market debut.
